param: the lensfun/darktable ptlens RADIUS NORMALIZATION actually applied by the production warp, measured end-to-end on a real frame
hypothesis: PRE-REGISTERED. The optics ledger (optical_state_d2_granularity_matrix) recorded its px verdicts under a MIN-HALF-DIM normalization and explicitly flagged the convention as unpinned ('radius-normalization convention must be pinned from lensfun source before final px verdicts'); TOOLS.md asserts lensfun rescales hugin-convention coefficients internally, unverified by probe. Two mutually exclusive conventions: H-DIAG r=1 at the frame CORNER (half-diagonal, 3643 px here) -> every ptlens model has ZERO displacement at the corner by construction and all four fitted/pinned models AGREE exactly there; H-MINDIM r=1 at half the SHORT side (2020 px) -> the corner sits at r=1.80, far outside the CP support (r<=1.0) where the cubic EXTRAPOLATES, and the recorded model-pair divergence there is 3.7-16.5 px.
discriminator: the RADIUS at which the measured warp displacement crosses zero, on a real calibrated frame through the production path (darktable --style lensdist vs --style nodist, same frame). Only one of 2020 px / 3643 px can be it.
instrument: Siril (calibrate/debayer/savetif32/findstar open gate) + darktable-cli (the production warp, --style-overwrite --icc-type LIN_REC709 bpp=32) + install_lens_model.sh; cross-match of the tools' own star lists, displacement vs radius
why_it_decides_the_smear: the failed observable is CORNER-ONLY star smear created at the cross-set compose. Under H-MINDIM the corner is unconstrained extrapolation and different members carry different corner geometry; under H-DIAG the corner is the one radius where all models agree and the mechanism must be elsewhere.
verdict: H-MINDIM CONFIRMED, H-DIAG KILLED. MEASURED end-to-end through the production warp (seeded synthetic star-field fixture at sensor geometry 6064x4040, darktable --style lensdist vs --style nodist, Siril findstar, 150 dots at 400 px pitch so no match is ambiguous): fitting the measured radial displacement of all four models simultaneously gives RMS 4.47 px for Rn = half SHORT side (2020 px), 18.27 px for half long side, 22.22 px for half DIAGONAL; a FREE Rn lands at 2000 px (1% of 2020). The normalisation is HALF THE SHORT SIDE. CONSEQUENCE: the frame CORNER is at rho = 3643/2020 = 1.80 while hugin's control points constrain the fit only to rho <= 1.0 — the ptlens cubic EXTRAPOLATES 80% beyond its support exactly where the defect lives, so fits that are interchangeable inside the supported field are free to disagree at the corners. MODEL-PAIR DIVERGENCE, measured (px, radial, peak over field): s02-vs-s03 8.19, s01-vs-s03 6.24, s02-vs-pinned 6.27, s01-vs-pinned 4.91, s01-vs-s02 2.80, s03-vs-pinned 1.91 — peaking near rho ~ 1. The identity control (nodist) closes at median |tangential| 0.50 px, max |radial| 0.71 px. SUPERSEDES the caveat in optical_state_d2_granularity_matrix ('radius-normalization convention must be pinned from lensfun source'): it is pinned, by probe, and the min-half-dim convention that ledger's px numbers used is the correct one. Also corrects TOOLS.md's unprobed claim that lensfun 'rescales hugin-convention coefficients internally' — no rescaling is needed or observed; hugin's half-short-side convention IS lensfun's.
